newsitem.title: USA: Eastman Kodak appoints president, chief operating officer.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Kodak appoints president, chief operating officer.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Corp. said Thursday it named Daniel Carp to the new post of president and chief operating officer.
Carp, who is currently executive vice president and assistant chief operating officer, will take on the new post on Jan. 1, 1997, the company said.
Carl Kohrt, now executive vice president and assistant chief operating officer, will continue in that role and report to Carp, Kodak said.

Kodak Chief Executive Officer George Fisher, who was also president and chief operating officer, said that for the past year, Carp had oversight responsibility for Kodak's consumer, professional, health and professional motion imaging businesses.
He also had responsibility for some of the company's manufacturing operations and the Latin American and Asia Pacific regions, Kodak said.
